name: PromptInput
purpose: An AI message composer with removable context, slash commands, and send or stop controls.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Hero gives landing-page prompts a spacious composer and a separate context strip.

guidance.overview: An AI message composer with removable context, slash commands, and send or stop controls.
usage: onSend receives the trimmed prompt and a snapshot of attached context. Return its promise so failed sends preserve the draft for retry.
Commands insert editable prompt text rather than submitting automatically. Customize commands for the host’s supported tasks.
Use generating and onStop to connect cancellation to a real request; the composer does not stop a backend operation on its own.
accessibility: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, and slash opens commands only in an otherwise empty draft. Composition input is respected.
Closing a context or command picker and removing an attachment returns focus to the composer; send errors are associated with the field.
context: Use with an explicit context-aware assistant, keeping attached records visible and removable before sending.
